servinfo.title: Time-Lag Test
servinfo.ptxt: This test is to check conditions of clutch, brake and fluid pressure. “Time-lag” means time elapsed since select lever is shifted with engine idling till shock is felt.

attention1.ptxt: If you do not select a suitable route and take proper precautions when performing a road test, an accident can occur.

item.ptxt: Select a level road with no traffic to minimize the risk of accident.
Perform the road test with 2 persons, a driver and a tester.

attention3.ptxt: Limit the driving speed permissible in road conditions and regulations.

s1.ptxt: Connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
Select “Data list” mode on scan tool.
Drive vehicle so that ATF temperature reaches normal operating temperature (50 to 80 °C (122 to 176 °F)).

attention3.ptxt: Engine coolant temperature rises when revving engine in P or N range, but ATF temperature does not rise in P or N range.
Drive vehicle to raise ATF temperature.

s1.ptxt: With chocks placed before and behind front and rear wheels respectively, depress brake pedal.
With a stopwatch ready, shift select lever from N to D range and measure time from that moment till shock is felt.
Similarly measure time-lag by shifting select lever from N to R range.

item.ptxt: When repeating this test, wait at least one minute after select lever is shifted back to N range.
Engine should be warmed up fully for this test.
Repeat test 3 times and take average of those data for final time-lag data.
